company.shortDescription: Tawfeer offers daily groceries at the best prices to the middle class through its mobile application backed by its fulfillment centers.
company.description:
Tawfeer kicked off operation in October 2019
Tawfeer is a mobile application where you can order groceries online to receive the products within the same day usually within 3 hours.
Products are sent from Tawfeer warehouses in Tawfeer branded bags with Tawfeer delivery boys.

insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
